name: grep
description: 按正则表达式搜索文件内容。三种输出模式：content（匹配行+可选上下文，默认）、files_with_matches（仅文件路径，省 token）、count（每文件匹配计数）。支持 glob/type 文件过滤、上下文行、smartCase、fixedStrings 字面量、multiline 跨行匹配、offset 分页。默认尊重 .gitignore/.ignore 并跳过二进制文件与 node_modules/.git/dist/build。
description_en: Search file contents by regular expression. Three output modes: content (matching lines + optional context, default), files_with_matches (file paths only, token-saving), count (match count per file). Supports glob/type file filtering, context lines, smartCase, fixedStrings literal matching, multiline cross-line matching, offset pagination. Respects .gitignore/.ignore by default and skips binary files and node_modules/.git/dist/build.

pattern.description: 要搜索的正则表达式模式（如 "function\s+\w+"、"TODO|FIXME"）；fixedStrings=true 时按字面量搜索无需转义
pattern.description_en: Regex pattern to search for (e.g. "function\s+\w+", "TODO|FIXME"); with fixedStrings=true it is searched literally, no escaping needed

path.description: 要搜索的文件或目录（默认：agent 工作目录）。绝对或相对路径
path.description_en: File or directory to search (default: agent working directory). Absolute or relative path

glob.description: 可选的文件名 glob 过滤器，如 "*.ts"、"**/*.json"、"*.{vue,svelte}"。仅搜索匹配的文件
glob.description_en: Optional filename glob filter, e.g. "*.ts", "**/*.json", "*.{vue,svelte}". Only matching files are searched

type.description: 按文件类型过滤（等价 rg --type）：ts/js/py/rust/go/java/kotlin/c/cpp/cs/rb/php/swift/md/json/yaml/toml/css/scss/less/html/vue/svelte/sh/bat/sql/xml/astro/graphql
type.description_en: Filter by file type (equivalent to rg --type): ts/js/py/rust/go/java/kotlin/c/cpp/cs/rb/php/swift/md/json/yaml/toml/css/scss/less/html/vue/svelte/sh/bat/sql/xml/astro/graphql

outputMode.description: 输出模式：content=匹配行带行号（默认）；files_with_matches=仅含匹配的文件路径（按修改时间降序，定位文件时用，最省 token）；count=每文件匹配行数（file:N 格式）
outputMode.description_en: Output mode: content=matching lines with line numbers (default); files_with_matches=only paths of files with matches (mtime descending, best for locating files, most token-saving); count=matching lines per file (file:N format)

caseInsensitive.description: 忽略大小写匹配（默认 false）

smartCase.description: 智能大小写（默认 false）：pattern 不含大写字母时自动忽略大小写，含大写则精确匹配。与 caseInsensitive 同 true 时以 caseInsensitive 为准
smartCase.description_en: Smart case (default false): automatically case-insensitive when the pattern contains no uppercase letters, exact otherwise. When both are true, caseInsensitive takes precedence

fixedStrings.description: 按字面量搜索 pattern（默认 false），正则元字符自动转义。搜含 . ( [ * 等字符的字符串时无需手动转义
fixedStrings.description_en: Search the pattern literally (default false); regex metacharacters are escaped automatically. No manual escaping needed when searching strings containing . ( [ * etc.

contextBefore.description: 匹配行前输出的上下文行数（默认 0，最大 10）。仅 content 模式生效
contextBefore.description_en: Number of context lines to output before each match (default 0, max 10). Only effective in content mode

contextAfter.description: 匹配行后输出的上下文行数（默认 0，最大 10）。仅 content 模式生效
contextAfter.description_en: Number of context lines to output after each match (default 0, max 10). Only effective in content mode

multiline.description: 跨行匹配模式（默认 false）：pattern 可用 [\s\S] 或 . 匹配换行（此模式下 . 自动跨行）。行号取匹配起始行；超过 1MB 的文件自动跳过
multiline.description_en: Cross-line matching mode (default false): the pattern may use [\s\S] or . to match newlines (. matches across lines in this mode). Line number is the first line of the match; files larger than 1MB are skipped automatically

maxResults.description: 最多返回的结果条数（默认 100，最大 500）。content 按匹配行、files_with_matches/count 按文件计
maxResults.description_en: Maximum number of result entries (default 100, max 500). Counted per matching line in content mode, per file in files_with_matches/count modes

offset.description: 分页偏移量（默认 0）。结果截断时配合使用可翻页
offset.description_en: Pagination offset (default 0). Use together when results are truncated to page through them

noIgnore.description: 不尊重 .gitignore/.ignore 且不跳过 node_modules/dist/build 等默认忽略目录（默认 false）
noIgnore.description_en: Do not respect .gitignore/.ignore and do not skip default ignored directories such as node_modules/dist/build (default false)

dot.description: 包含隐藏文件（. 开头，默认 false）

respectGitignore.description: 是否默认尊重 .gitignore（false 等同全局 noIgnore）

maxContextLines.description: contextBefore/contextAfter 允许的最大值（默认 10）
